penicillin.message: Patient has penicillin allergy. {drug} is a penicillin-type antibiotic. Consider azithromycin or doxycycline.

cephalosporin.message: Patient has cephalosporin allergy. {drug} is a cephalosporin. Consider azithromycin, fluoroquinolone, or doxycycline.

sulfa.message: Patient has sulfa allergy. {drug} contains sulfonamide. Use alternative antibiotic. Note: cross-reactivity with thiazide diuretics is rare but possible.

macrolide.message: Patient has macrolide allergy. {drug} is a macrolide antibiotic. Consider doxycycline or amoxicillin.

fluoroquinolone.message: Patient has fluoroquinolone allergy. {drug} is a fluoroquinolone. Consider alternative antibiotic based on sensitivity.

nsaid.message: Patient has NSAID allergy. {drug} is an NSAID. Use paracetamol for pain relief.

aspirin.message: Patient has aspirin allergy. {drug} may cross-react. Consider alternative analgesic or antiplatelet.

opioid.message: Patient has opioid allergy. {drug} is an opioid. Use non-opioid alternatives (paracetamol, NSAIDs if tolerated).

ace_inhibitor.message: Patient has ACE inhibitor allergy (angioedema risk). {drug} is an ACE inhibitor. Use ARB (losartan) or calcium channel blocker instead.

abacavir.message: Patient has abacavir hypersensitivity (HLA-B*5701). {drug} is CONTRAINDICATED — can cause fatal reaction. Use TDF-based regimen instead.

nevirapine.message: Patient has nevirapine allergy (Stevens-Johnson syndrome risk). {drug} is CONTRAINDICATED. Use efavirenz or dolutegravir-based regimen.

isoniazid.message: Patient has isoniazid allergy. {drug} should not be used. Consult TB treatment guidelines for alternative regimen.

rifampicin.message: Patient has rifampicin hypersensitivity. {drug} should not be used. Consult TB specialist for alternative regimen.

local_anesthetic.message: Patient has local anesthetic allergy. {drug} is a local anesthetic. Use alternative agent or refer for allergy testing.

tetracycline.message: Patient has tetracycline allergy. {drug} is a tetracycline. Consider azithromycin or amoxicillin as alternative.

aminoglycoside.message: Patient has aminoglycoside allergy. {drug} is an aminoglycoside. Use alternative antibiotic based on culture sensitivity.
